key.headline: Safe ten days only with relief restored
key.request: VIP-18 must be isolated between XV-101 and XV-102 for several days of maintenance while partially filled with LNG. Design a safe isolation: what must be in place so the blocked-in segment never exceeds its design pressure for up to 10 days at the worst credible heat leak, verify it in the simulator, and list the procedure and alarm requirements.
titles: Put PSV-101 back in service (reopen HV-101) before any block-in of VIP-18
